name: The Heartlands
title: The Heartlands: Central Faerûn
description: The Heartlands form the central core of Faerûn, stretching from the Sword Coast to the Sea of Fallen Stars. It is a region of prosperous kingdoms and ancient forests.
wiki: The Heartlands is a broad geographic term for the central regions of Faerûn. It includes major powers like Cormyr and Sembia, as well as the Dalelands and the Western Heartlands.
